description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_NameSync' that performs validation and synchronization of 'name' and 'id' HTML attributes, used as part of an HTML attribute transformation pipeline in the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_NameSync
classes.description: A class responsible for ensuring that if a 'name' attribute is present with an equivalent 'id' attribute, it is passed through; otherwise, validation is performed on the 'name' attribute to ensure it is valid and consistent.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class, setting up an ID attribute validator.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Performs validation and synchronization of 'name' and 'id' attributes within an attribute array, ensuring consistency and validity based on configuration and context.
